timeline_staffing.text: Describe your approach to implementing AEM Sites, including a timeline and staffing plan.

lines.name: Site build with components and templates
Cloud Manager program, pipelines and access
Author training on the Universal Editor

timeline_staffing.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with AEM Sites.

What we would do
- We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.
- We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
- We will train authors to edit pages and content in the Universal Editor and hand over authoring guides for the site's components and templates.

After launch
- Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.

experience_banks.text: Describe your experience implementing Adobe Experience Manager Sites for banks.

lines.name: Cloud Manager program, pipelines and access
Site build with components and templates
Author training on the Universal Editor

experience_banks.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with AEM Sites.

What we would do
- We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
- We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.
- We will work through Adobe's go-live checklist: a production pipeline with functional and UI tests, Dispatcher validation, CDN, SSL and DNS, performance and security tests on stage, notification profiles and traffic filter rules.
- We will train authors to edit pages and content in the Universal Editor and hand over authoring guides for the site's components and templates.
